review.audio: Every stored MP3 decoded with ffmpeg -map 0:a:0 -vn. Sources identify kill/inspect/finisher clips; none is an authenticated standalone gunfire sample.
review.banners: Reviewed actual RGBA pixels in banners-contact-sheet.jpg. These are transparent composite icons with frames, emblems and ornaments already combined; independent animation/headshot layers were not supplied.
review.provenance: Local wiki download manifest paths and hashes verified against bytes. All 79 tracked kill clips match decoded source PCM; 76 pairs are also byte-identical.
review.scope: 30 catalog weapon/theme fire combinations remain missing. Do not relabel inspection or finisher audio as gunfire.
